player_prompt.intro:
I khelh mek Minesweeper game.
He game thil tum ber chu mine awm lohna cell zawng zawng pho chhuah a ni.
Move siam turin, row leh column coordinate zawng zawng pho chhuah duh i neihte chu hetiang hian ziak:
- `[row col]`: Row leh column i ziah zawng zawng a cell pho chhuah.
Entirnan:
- `[3 2]` Row 3, Column 2 a cell pho chhuah.
- `[5 6]` Row 5, Column 6 a cell pho chhuah.
I move hmasa berah, i thlang cell chung leh a chhehvela cell pho chhuah vek a ni a, tan sahim a ni thei nana.
Board layout tunlai chu a hnuai ami a ni. Cell pho chhuah lohte chu dot ('.') in an ziak a, number pho chhuah chu mine kar a awm zat an entir.
Cell pho chhuah tawhte thlang leh suh u.
Board layout tunlai chu heti ami a ni:

invalid_move.wrong_format: A dikna tûr coordinate chu a ni lo.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: A row leh a column coordinate chu bounds-a awm lo.
invalid_move.already_revealed: Cell ({row}, {col}) chu pho chhuah tawh a ni.
invalid_move.hit_mine: I mine at ({row}, {col}) hi i tu.

game_action.revealed: I cell chuang at ({row}, {col}) hi i tichhuak.

outcome.win: Ka lawm e, Minesweeper board chu i tifai ta a ni.
outcome.turn_limit: Turn limit a tawp tawh. I cell him tak {percent}% chu i pho chhuak a ni.
